2026-06-25 00:00

Dear passengers,

We advise you to comply with the requirement of the airlines and be at the airport two hours before the flight, as the Bulgarian Civil Aviation Administration recommends to be at least two hours and thirty minutes before the flight.

Parking Information at Vasil Levski Sofia Airport

We kindly remind all travelers planning to arrive at Vasil Levski Sofia Airport by car to familiarize themselves in advance with the parking locations and pricing details. This information is available on our website: https://sofia-airport.eu/en/at-the-airport/parking/.

📍 Useful Information:

A detailed map of the parking areas is available at the airport entrance.

Pricing details are clearly displayed at the entry barriers.

Parking Options at Sofia Airport:

P2 – Comfort parking, direct lift access to Terminal 2

P3 – Standard parking for passenger convenience

P4 – Economy parking for longer stays

P5 – Short-stay parking, ideal for drop-off and pick-up

P8 – Dedicated parking for buses serving large groups

—

We remind you to comply with the requirement of the airlines and be at the airport two hours before your flight.

—

Travelers, their greeters and dispatchers – follow the flight information on our official website for the terminal where your flights take off and land. It is constantly updated and available 24/7.

—

Important information for travelers to Varna and Burgas!
If you are planning a domestic flight from Sofia Airport, it is advisable to be at the airport 2 hours before your departure. From now on, flights will be served from gates located in the inner part of Terminal 2.
This means that you will have the opportunity to take advantage of the shops, restaurants and business lounge located in Terminal 2 before your journey.

Have a nice trip!

Landing aircraft at Sofia Airport

Planes of various airlines land at both terminals of Sofia Airport. You can check which one your flight is scheduled for on the airport’s website or on your boarding pass.

 

Once you leave the plane, depending on whether you land on the passenger sleeve or at the stand, you will either walk or be taken to the terminal by bus.

 

If your journey will continue on a connecting flight after your arrival at Sofia Airport, follow the latest flight information and follow the signs to the appropriate gate. Be sure to collect your luggage if it has not been checked in by your final destination.

 

Before you get to the baggage area to collect yours, you will go through the border crossings to check your identity documents. It’s a good idea to get them ready in advance to avoid crowds and queues. For convenience, you can also use the electronic border check counters located at Terminal 2. See more here.

 

Information on customs restrictions and goods, cash and other valuables to be declared on entry into the country can be obtained from DG Customs. Specific enquiries can also be directed to +359 2 980 4500.

 

The Orders of the Minister of Health on the restriction of the spread of COVID-19 are still in force upon entry into Bulgaria. They are published on the website of the Ministry of Health and contain information on the documents required for free entry into Bulgaria.

 

Leaving the airport building you have several options for getting to the city centre. A convenient connection from Terminal 2 is offered by the metropolitan metro, which connects the airport with the historical centre of Sofia, as well as with Central Railway Station, and  the districts of Druzhba, Mladost, Lyulin, Hadji Dimitar and Gorna Banya.

 

Electric buses 184 and 84 offer a quick connection to the centre of the capital.

 

If you choose a taxi, the company with which the airport operator SOF Connect has a contract is Yellow!, which gives security to travellers.

 

If you need to move between Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, you can use the free inter-terminal shuttle. The bus operates 24/7 on the route Terminal 1 – Terminal 2 – Terminal. The up-to-dated schedule is available here.

 

For up-to-date and useful information about Sofia and the surrounding area, arriving passengers can visit the official website of Sofia Municipality or the information desks in the public area of Terminal 1 and Terminal 2.
